description.en: Configure which models pstack uses per role and at what reasoning budget. Detects your available models and writes an always-applied rule that overrides the skill defaults. Use for /setup-pstack, "configure pstack models", "pstack budget", or changing pstack's model choices.
description.zh: 设置 pstack 每个角色用哪个模型、用多大的推理预算。它会查出你能用的模型，写一条始终生效的规则，覆盖技能的默认设置。用于 /setup-pstack、「configure pstack models」、「pstack budget」，或者想改 pstack 的模型选择时。

blocks.en: # Setup pstack
blocks.zh: # Setup pstack（设置 pstack）

blocks.en: Write pstack's model settings, one model per role:
blocks.zh: 写入 pstack 的模型设置，每个角色一个模型：

blocks.en:
- **Cursor:** `~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc`, an always-applied rule.
- **Claude Code:** `~/.claude/rules/pstack-models.md`. Claude Code loads every file in `~/.claude/rules/` into each new session.
- **Every other harness** (Codex, Pi, OpenCode, and others): `~/.agents/pstack-models.md`. These harnesses don't load it on their own, so pstack skills read this file when they pick a model.
blocks.zh:
- **Cursor：** `~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc`，一条始终生效的规则。
- **Claude Code：** `~/.claude/rules/pstack-models.md`。Claude Code 会把 `~/.claude/rules/` 里的每个文件都载入每个新会话。
- **其他所有工具**（Codex、Pi、OpenCode 等）：`~/.agents/pstack-models.md`。这些工具不会自己载入它，所以 pstack 的技能在挑模型时会读这个文件。

blocks.en: "The settings file" below means the file for your harness. In Claude Code, if that file is missing, read `~/.agents/pstack-models.md` instead, where older versions of this skill wrote it.
blocks.zh: 下文说的「设置文件」，指的是你所用工具对应的那个文件。在 Claude Code 里，如果那个文件不存在，就改读 `~/.agents/pstack-models.md`，这个技能的旧版本把设置写在那里。

blocks.en: ## Steps
blocks.zh: ## 步骤

blocks.en: ### 1. Detect available models
blocks.zh: ### 1. 查出能用的模型

blocks.en: Enumerate the model slugs you can pass to a subagent in this session (Cursor `Task`, Claude Code `Agent`, OpenCode `task`, Codex `spawn_agent`). That is the dependable source. If your harness also has a command that lists the user's models, prefer it for completeness (for example `opencode models` or `pi --list-models`). If you cannot detect any, ask the user to paste the slugs they have access to. Never write a real slug you have not confirmed is available. The aliases `inherit-parent` and `auto` are always valid even though they are not detected slugs.
blocks.zh: 列出这次会话里你能传给帮手 AI 的模型名（slug），也就是 Cursor 的 `Task`、Claude Code 的 `Agent`、OpenCode 的 `task`、Codex 的 `spawn_agent` 能接受的那些。这是靠得住的来源。如果你所用的工具还有一条能列出用户模型的命令，为了列全，优先用它（比如 `opencode models` 或 `pi --list-models`）。如果一个都查不到，就请用户把自己能用的模型名贴过来。没确认能用的真实模型名，绝不写进去。别名 `inherit-parent` 和 `auto` 永远有效，尽管它们不是查出来的模型名。

blocks.en: ### 2. Load current state
blocks.zh: ### 2. 读取当前状态

blocks.en: The default role-to-model mapping is the rule shape shown in step 5 below. If the settings file already exists, read it and treat its `# budget` line and its role values as the current choices. Otherwise start from those defaults. A line whose role is not in step 5, such as `how critics`, is from a retired role. Drop it.
blocks.zh: 默认的角色和模型对应关系，就是下面第 5 步给出的规则格式。如果设置文件已经存在，就读它，把它的 `# budget` 那一行和各角色的值当作当前的选择。否则就从这些默认值开始。如果某一行的角色不在第 5 步里，比如 `how critics`，那是已经撤掉的角色，删掉这一行。

blocks.en: ### 3. Budget, map, and confirm
blocks.zh: ### 3. 定预算、对应模型、确认

blocks.en: **(a) Ask for a budget.** Prefer your structured-question tool (`AskQuestion` in Cursor, `AskUserQuestion` in Claude Code, `question` in OpenCode) over free text. Offer these four options with these exact labels, and name the current budget when the rule records one. With no rule, say that `large` matches the skill defaults.
blocks.zh: **(a) 问预算。** 优先用你的结构化提问工具（Cursor 里的 `AskQuestion`、Claude Code 里的 `AskUserQuestion`、OpenCode 里的 `question`），不要用自由文本。给出下面这四个选项，标签要和这里逐字一样；如果规则里记着当前预算，就说出来。如果没有规则，就说明 `large` 和技能的默认设置一致。

blocks.en:
- `unlimited — max reasoning`
- `large — xhigh reasoning`
- `medium — high reasoning`
- `small — medium reasoning`
blocks.zh:
- `unlimited — max reasoning`
- `large — xhigh reasoning`
- `medium — high reasoning`
- `small — medium reasoning`

blocks.en: **(b) Apply it.** Build the working table from the skill defaults, and on a re-run keep any role you changed by family, list, or alias (`inherit-parent`, `auto`). `unlimited`, `large`, `medium`, and `small` set the effort token of every real slug, panel entries included, to `max`, `xhigh`, `high`, or `medium`. The effort token is the last token, or the one before a trailing `fast`, on the ladder `max` > `xhigh` > `high` > `medium` > `low`. If the result is not a detected slug, use the same family's detected slug with the highest effort at or below the target, else mark the role as needing a choice. `inherit-parent` and `auto` do not change. So `unlimited` turns `claude-opus-5-5-xhigh` into `claude-opus-5-5-max`. Grok slugs top out at `xhigh`, so under `unlimited` the fallback puts Grok at `xhigh` and keeps `grok-4.7-xhigh-fast` as it is. `large` keeps both defaults. `small` turns them into `claude-opus-5-5-medium` and `grok-4.7-medium-fast`.
blocks.zh: **(b) 套用预算。** 从技能的默认设置建一张工作表；如果是重跑，保留你按系列、列表或别名（`inherit-parent`、`auto`）改过的角色。`unlimited`、`large`、`medium`、`small` 会把每个真实模型名（包括小组列表里的条目）的强度标记分别设为 `max`、`xhigh`、`high`、`medium`。强度标记是模型名的最后一段；如果最后一段是 `fast`，就是它前面那一段。强度从高到低是 `max` > `xhigh` > `high` > `medium` > `low`。如果结果不是查出来的模型名，就用同一系列里、强度不超过目标的最高那个已查出的模型名；没有的话，就把这个角色标成需要选择。`inherit-parent` 和 `auto` 不变。所以 `unlimited` 会把 `claude-opus-5-5-xhigh` 变成 `claude-opus-5-5-max`。Grok 的模型名最高只到 `xhigh`，所以在 `unlimited` 下，这条退而求其次的规则让 Grok 停在 `xhigh`，`grok-4.7-xhigh-fast` 保持原样。`large` 两个默认值都不变。`small` 会把它们变成 `claude-opus-5-5-medium` 和 `grok-4.7-medium-fast`。

blocks.en: **(c) Show the roles and confirm.** Show every role with its model, marking any real slug not in the detected set as needing a choice. Also list each line step 2 dropped. Ask whether to accept as-is or change specific roles, offering the detected models plus `inherit-parent` and `auto` (both mean: this role runs on the parent chat model, which is how Auto users stay on Auto) as the options. Prefer your structured-question tool over free text. For panel roles (arena runners, architect runners, interrogate reviewers) the value is a list, and one subagent runs per entry, alias entries included, so the list length sets the count. `arena cross-judge pool` is also a list, but Arena runs one judge. It tries only values from a family other than the parent's, in list order, so order it by preference. An `inherit-parent` or `auto` value never judges. `swarm workers` is the default model for every worker unless a race or comparison assigns another model per arm.
blocks.zh: **(c) 列出角色并确认。** 列出每个角色和它的模型，凡是不在已查出集合里的真实模型名，都标成需要选择。第 2 步删掉的每一行也列出来。问用户是照单全收，还是改某几个角色；选项是查出来的模型，再加上 `inherit-parent` 和 `auto`（两者都表示：这个角色用主对话的模型跑，用 Auto 的用户就是靠这个一直留在 Auto 上）。优先用你的结构化提问工具，不要用自由文本。小组角色（arena runners、architect runners、interrogate reviewers）的值是一个列表，每个条目跑一个帮手 AI，别名条目也算，所以列表有多长，就跑几个。`arena cross-judge pool` 也是一个列表，但 Arena 只跑一个评委。它只试和主对话模型不同系列的值，按列表顺序试，所以要按你的偏好排序。值为 `inherit-parent` 或 `auto` 的条目永远不当评委。`swarm workers` 是每个干活帮手的默认模型，除非竞速或比较时给每一路另外指定了模型。

blocks.en: ### 4. Validate
Every real slug written must be in the detected set. `inherit-parent` and `auto` always pass. If a chosen real slug is not available, stop and ask again.
blocks.zh: 写进去的每个真实模型名都必须在已查出的集合里。`inherit-parent` 和 `auto` 永远通过。如果选中的某个真实模型名用不了，就停下来重新问。

blocks.en: ### 5. Write the rule

Write the settings file with a `# budget` line with the chosen label and its target effort, and one line per role, using the same labels poteto-mode uses. In Cursor, include the frontmatter below with `alwaysApply: true`. In other harnesses, write the settings file without the frontmatter (start at the first `#` line). Overwrite the whole file so re-runs stay idempotent. Shape:
blocks.zh: 写设置文件：一行 `# budget`，写上选定的标签和它对应的目标强度；每个角色一行，用和 poteto-mode 相同的标签。在 Cursor 里，带上下面的 frontmatter，其中写 `alwaysApply: true`。在其他工具里，写设置文件时不带 frontmatter（从第一个 `#` 行开始）。整个文件覆盖重写，这样重跑多少次结果都一样。格式：

blocks.en:
```
---
description: pstack per-role model choices (overrides skill defaults)
alwaysApply: true
---
# pstack model configuration. One line per role. Delete a line to fall back to the skill default.
# `inherit-parent` or `auto` as a value: the role runs on the parent chat model (omit the subagent `model`). Alias entries in a panel list still count toward its fan-out.
# budget: large (xhigh)
feature, refactoring: grok-4.7-xhigh-fast
bug-fix: grok-4.7-xhigh-fast
perf-issue: grok-4.7-xhigh-fast
hillclimb: grok-4.7-xhigh-fast
judgment and prose: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh
hardest tasks: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh
how explorer: grok-4.7-xhigh-fast
how explainer: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh
why investigators: grok-4.7-xhigh-fast
why synthesizer: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh
reflect tooling: grok-4.7-xhigh-fast
reflect judgment, divergent, synthesizer: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh
arena runners: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh, grok-4.7-xhigh-fast
arena cross-judge pool: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh, grok-4.7-xhigh-fast
swarm workers: grok-4.7-xhigh-fast
architect runners: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh, grok-4.7-xhigh-fast
interrogate reviewers: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh, grok-4.7-xhigh-fast
```

blocks.en: ### 6. Confirm

Tell the user which file was written. In Cursor and Claude Code, it applies to new sessions. In other harnesses, pstack skills read `~/.agents/pstack-models.md` when they pick a model. Re-running this skill updates it.
blocks.zh: 告诉用户写的是哪个文件。在 Cursor 和 Claude Code 里，它对新会话生效。在其他工具里，pstack 的技能挑模型时会读 `~/.agents/pstack-models.md`。重跑这个技能就会更新它。

blocks.en: ### 7. Offer a verification skill (optional)
blocks.zh: ### 7. 提议生成一个验证技能（可选）

blocks.en: Check whether the project has a way to drive the real app for proof (a `verify-*` skill, or an existing harness). If not, offer once: "want a project-local verification skill, so agents can drive the app the way a user does and prove changes work? I can generate one with /create-verification-skill." On yes, invoke `/create-verification-skill` (resolves wherever pstack is installed: workspace, user, or plugin). On no, move on without pushing.
blocks.zh: 看看项目里有没有办法驱动真实应用来拿证据（一个 `verify-*` 技能，或者现成的驱动工具）。如果没有，就提议一次：「要不要一个放在项目里的验证技能？这样 AI 就能像用户那样操作应用，证明改动有效。我可以用 /create-verification-skill 生成一个。」对方答应，就调用 `/create-verification-skill`（不管 pstack 装在哪里都能找到：工作区、用户目录或插件）。对方拒绝，就接着往下走，不要硬推。

blocks.en: ### 8. Offer a formal verification skill (optional)
blocks.zh: ### 8. 提议生成一个形式化验证技能（可选）

blocks.en: Check whether the project already has a formal verification skill (a project skill that runs a model checker, a proof, or another verifier against the code). If not, offer once: "want a formal verification skill, so agents can prove a key property of your code holds in every case in scope, not only the cases tests reach? I can generate one with /create-formal-verification-skill." On yes, invoke `/create-formal-verification-skill` (resolves wherever pstack is installed: workspace, user, or plugin). On no, move on without pushing.
blocks.zh: 看看项目里是不是已经有形式化验证技能（一个对代码运行模型检查器、证明或其他验证器的项目技能）。如果没有，就提议一次：「要不要一个形式化验证技能？这样 AI 就能证明你代码里的一条关键性质在范围内的每种情况下都成立，而不只是测试碰得到的那些情况。我可以用 /create-formal-verification-skill 生成一个。」对方答应，就调用 `/create-formal-verification-skill`（不管 pstack 装在哪里都能找到：工作区、用户目录或插件）。对方拒绝，就接着往下走，不要硬推。

lessons.quote: Never write a real slug you have not confirmed is available.
lessons.quoteZh: 没确认能用的真实模型名，绝不写进去。

zh.title: 没确认过的不许写
zh.does: 配置里只会出现你真能用的模型，不会冒出一个编出来的名字让运行失败。
zh.why: 「绝不」加上「确认」这个具体动作，比一句「要准确」难绕过得多。
zh.try: 让 AI 整理报价时写：「只列你在官网上确认过的价格，查不到的写『未确认』。」

en.title: Write only what's confirmed
en.does: Only models you can actually use end up in the settings, never a made-up name that breaks a run.
en.why: "Never" tied to a concrete step, confirming, is much harder to slip past than "be accurate".
en.try: When you ask for a price list: "List only prices you confirmed on the official site; mark the rest 'unconfirmed'."

lessons.quote: Offer these four options with these exact labels
lessons.quoteZh: 给出下面这四个选项，标签要和这里逐字一样

zh.title: 把选项一字不差写出来
zh.does: 它问预算时，每次都给你同样的四个选项，说法也一样。
zh.why: 把选项原样写进提示词并要求照抄，AI 就不会自己改写、多加一个或漏掉一个。
zh.try: 让 AI 做问卷时写：「问满意度只给三个选项：『满意』『一般』『不满意』，原样照抄。」

en.title: Spell out the exact options
en.does: It asks about budget with the same four options every time, worded the same way.
en.why: Writing the options into the prompt and asking for them verbatim stops the AI from rewording, adding or dropping one.
en.try: For a survey: "Ask about satisfaction with exactly these options: 'Satisfied', 'OK', 'Not satisfied'."

lessons.quoteZh: 所以 `unlimited` 会把 `claude-opus-5-5-xhigh` 变成 `claude-opus-5-5-max`。

zh.title: 规则后面跟个算好的例子
zh.does: 它按预算换模型时不容易算错，比如选最大预算，就把 xhigh 换成 max。
zh.why: 抽象的换算规则容易读偏，紧跟一个算好的例子，AI 能拿自己的结果对一对。
zh.try: 给换算规则时顺手举例：「金额四舍五入到百位，比如 1,260 写成 1,300。」

en.title: Follow a rule with an example
en.does: It swaps models for your budget correctly, such as turning xhigh into max for the biggest budget.
en.why: An abstract conversion rule is easy to misread; a worked example right after lets the AI check its own answer.
en.try: Give an example with the rule: "Round amounts to the nearest hundred, so 1,260 becomes 1,300."

lessons.quote: On no, move on without pushing.
lessons.quoteZh: 对方拒绝，就接着往下走，不要硬推。

zh.title: 只问一次，被拒就停
zh.does: 它只提一次要不要生成验证技能，你说不要，它就不再提。
zh.why: 写明问几次、被拒后怎么办，AI 就不会一遍遍推销附加功能。
zh.try: 让 AI 写文章时加一句：「结尾可以问一次要不要配图；我说不用，就别再提。」

en.title: Ask once, drop it on no
en.does: It offers a verification skill once, and drops it if you say no.
en.why: Saying how many times to ask and what to do on a no keeps the AI from pitching extras again and again.
en.try: When the AI writes for you: "You may ask once at the end whether I want images; if I say no, drop it."

en.intro: It lists where the settings file goes in Cursor, Claude Code and every other harness.
sections: Eight steps, from finding usable models to writing the file, ending with two optional offers.
Lists the model names it can pass to helpers this session. If it finds none, it asks you to paste yours.
Reads an existing file's budget and role choices as the starting point, and drops lines for retired roles.
Asks for unlimited, large, medium or small, sets each model's effort to match, then shows the roles to accept or change.
Checks every chosen model is in the detected list. If one isn't, it stops and asks again.
Writes a budget line and one line per role over the whole file. The Cursor version adds `alwaysApply: true`.
Tells you which file it wrote. In Cursor and Claude Code, new sessions pick it up.
If the project has no way to drive the app, it offers once to generate one with `/create-verification-skill`.
If there is no formal verification skill, it offers once to run `/create-formal-verification-skill`. On no, it moves on.
